question: Should this runtime i18n PR make gateway JSON error message/reason fields locale-dependent, or should those protocol-facing strings stay stable while only chat/display copy is localized?
rationale: The code can mechanically preserve authMode billing behavior, but only maintainers can decide whether existing gateway clients may rely on these human-readable JSON fields as stable protocol text.

options.title: Keep Gateway Protocol Text Stable
options.body: Localize chat/runtime display copy while leaving gateway JSON message/reason fields stable unless a typed display field is added later.

options.title: Accept Localized Gateway Display Fields
options.body: Treat code/type fields as the only stable gateway contract and allow message/reason text to follow OPENCLAW_LOCALE after the branch is refreshed.

options.title: Pause Runtime I18n Scope
options.body: Limit this PR to non-protocol runtime chat copy and track broader gateway localization separately.

recommendation.title: Keep Gateway Protocol Text Stable
recommendation.body: Localize chat/runtime display copy while leaving gateway JSON message/reason fields stable unless a typed display field is added later.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and refined the foundational wizard i18n surface, so this product-boundary decision is closest to that i18n ownership history.
